organism.label: Tessaracoccus lapidicaptus
organism.strain: CECT 8385 = DSM 27266 = IPBSL-7, linked by NCBI type-material names and LPSN; primary Methods gives CECT/DSM
organism.naming_limit: Article abstract and portions of text use Tessarococcus; Methods, NCBI and LPSN use Tessaracoccus.

primary_evidence.version: Publisher PDF, Frontiers in Microbiology 6:1024, published 22 September 2015; 9 pages. Europe PMC full XML is same article, not another experiment.
primary_evidence.inspected: Read primary Methods, Results and relevant Discussion; visually inspected Figure 1 XRD, Figure 2 TEM/EDX, Figures 3-4 SEM/EDX and IMA rows. Table 1 PHREEQC predictions checked against text. No raw diffraction refit or quantified phase analysis.
primary_evidence.conditions: Living CECT 8385 (=DSM 27266), anoxic FE medium, initial pH6, 30C, reported100mL bottles with100mL medium, monitored up to45days, inoculum OD6000.5. FeCl2 supplies FeII. Full wt/vol medium constituents retained in records; methods give no inoculum volume or replicate count.
primary_evidence.controls: Uninoculated and nonviable-cell media reportedly showed no mineral or pH change. Nonviable preparation/viability assay not described; no pH-matched abiotic control or direct perturbation of phosphatases/EPS.
primary_evidence.outcome: Bulk XRD identifies dominant vivianite with siderite, supported by complementary microscopy/EDX. Fe-P crystals and carbonate aggregates occur around cells/EPS. Mixed formation is not isolated-product recovery or proof of enzyme/FeIII reduction mechanisms.
primary_evidence.inconsistencies: Results final pH approximately7.5 versus Discussion7.8. Introduction mistakenly prints siderite Fe2CO3; authoritative IMA and source Table1 use FeCO3. FeII0.56to0.01g/L sampling/filtration fraction unresolved. Figure2 Results/caption cross-reference letters imperfect; record cites complementary images without copying those misreferences.
primary_evidence.model_limits: Table1 initial saturation indices vivianite9.08/siderite2.40 are modelled, not precipitation observations. Proposed phosphatase activity, metabolic carbonate supply, mineral order, generalized natural occurrence and fertilizer utility are not experimentally isolated or adopted as measured outcomes.
primary_evidence.supplement_scope: Downloaded full XML has zero supplementary-material elements, and full PDF text search has no supplement section; first search result sets gave no separate supplement. This bounds inspected availability, not global absence.
primary_evidence.adverse_search: No correction/retraction notice or directly refuting experiment appeared in returned result sets; no exhaustive absence claim. Internal control and pH/chemistry limits remain explicit.

deduplication.command: rg --no-ignore --hidden --follow across worktree except .git/.venv; separate text/XML/JSON/Markdown searches and full ignored-inclusive file inventories for named raw directories.

deduplication.finding: Before creation, no vivianite/siderite root record or DOI10.3389/fmicb.2015.01024/Tessaracoccus experiment was found in repository boundaries. Prior round5 iron report mentions siderite as contaminant; retained raw Sklute2023 references siderite and a vivianite-like phase in other systems, not the accepted experiment. IMA retained raw naturally contains both mineral names. Binary files were inventoried and selected primary/identity PDFs extracted; not every historical binary was reread or a machine-wide search.
